content:
With \(N\) significant figures, the rounding unit in the coefficient of a number of order \(10^{30}\) is
\[
10^{-(N-1)}.
\]
Here
\[
10^{10}=10^{-20}\times 10^{30},
\]
so the added term affects only the 21st significant digit of the coefficient.

For the term to be lost in rounding, we need
\[
10^{-20}<\frac12\cdot 10^{-(N-1)},
\]
which gives \(N\le 20\).

Indeed, at \(N=20\), both \(2^{100}\) and \(2^{100}+10^{10}\) round to the same value; at \(N=21\), they round differently, so the result is no longer \(0\).

Therefore, the maximum number of significant figures taken is
\[
\boxed{20}.
\]
